item.text: {"search_note":"I found no strong 2024 evidence that Jokowi dismantled, reined in, or systematically punished abusive police/military behavior beyond the March torture case response. I also found no direct 2024 evidence that party enforcers, informal loyalists, or vigilantes were a central, openly tolerated tool of regime control under Jokowi in the security sense asked here. The record is concentrated in Papua.
